name: Ghost-o-Plasm
summary: Ghost-o-Plasm is ghostly energy gathered from Magrami Spectres in Desolace. Hornizz Brimbuzzle hopes to sell it to the Magram centaurs.

sections.title: Gathered in the Valley
sections.body: Between the two great skeletons called the Dead Goliaths, a crate of ghost magnets draws Magrami Spectres from the Valley of Bones. Their ghost-o-plasm is what Hornizz Brimbuzzle wants. He hopes the Magram centaurs will pay well for it, though he still has to convince them what the strange substance is.

faq.answer: Ghost-o-Plasm is ghostly energy taken from Magrami Spectres in Desolace.
Magrami Spectres in the Valley of Bones yield Ghost-o-Plasm when drawn to a crate of ghost magnets.
Hornizz Brimbuzzle wants Ghost-o-Plasm, hoping to sell it to the Magram centaurs.
Hornizz believes the Magram centaurs will pay well for captured ghost energy.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may recognize Hornizz's ghost magnets as clever devices, though his plan depends on what the Magram centaurs will pay.
As a member of the Horde, you are helping Hornizz bargain with the Magram centaurs through a strange trade in ghost energy.
